text:
maria: Heads-up — NexTherm quota tuning for dedicated pool tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need a concise runbook for burst gating, canary routing, and fallback behavior.

ashley: Got it. Quick numbers from sales: steady-state ~30k tokens/min, expected burst up to 120k tokens/min for short windows.

ton y: From infra: recommend autoscale policy that supports steady 30k and surges up to 150k tokens/min with a 2-min smoothing window. Cooldown 300s. Also enable per-customer KV prefix to reduce token cost.

tony: Autoscale snippet we tested:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  target_cpu: 65
  surge_tokens_per_min: 150000
  smoothing_window_s: 120
  cooldown_s: 300
```

maria: Nice. Can we run a staging dry-run tonight? Need load script, throttling knobs, and a rollback checklist if latency spikes. @kevin can you confirm customer ok with shadowing?

kevin: NexTherm approved shadowing low-rate traffic for 1h. They want an immediate rollback if p95 latency > 500ms or error rate > 1%. I'll own the customer comms. :thumbsup:

ashley: Rollback plan (high level): R1 - switch routing from dedicated -> shared fallback, R2 - pause burst token allowances, R3 - notify account + open incident. I'll put steps and triggers into the runbook.

sam_engineer: I'll queue a 30m soak then a 10m controlled burst using vegeta. My plan: ramp 5m -> burst 10m -> cool down. Script below.
```
echo "POST https://staging.redwood.com/v1/generate" > payload.txt
vegeta attack -rate=200 -duration=10m -targets=payload.txt | vegeta report
```

ton y: Ensure headers set for reserved context and quota: `X-Redwood-Tier: reserved` and `X-Quota-Limit:150000`. Also add trace tag `nextherm-burst` so we can filter in observability.

maria: Also capture quality: run 100 eval prompts pre/post-test to catch generation regressions. Eval set: https://redwood-infra/internal/evals/nextherm-bench (use same seed).

kevin: I'll flag renewal risk: if we require >2 rollbacks or any customer-impacting incident during rollout we mark account as 'at-risk' and notify AMs.

ashley: Finance check: confirm burst billing mapping (reserved vs overage). I'll update the runbook with the cost mapping table and approval gate.

sam_engineer: Quick cache-hit test command for staging (so we can validate prefix caching):
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'X-Redwood-Tier: reserved' -d @payload.txt \
  https://staging.redwood.com/v1/generate?cache_prefix=user123
# agent logs will include cache_hit=true on hits
```

maria: Action items: A1) sam run staging soak tonight 23:00 PT (staging-run id -> post here), A2) tony validate autoscale policy + add fallback hooks, A3) kevin confirm customer notice + renewal flag thresholds, A4) ashley add billing mapping to runbook and publish. Reconvene 08:30 PT tomorrow for go/no-go.

tony: :eyes: I'll add the fallback automation (route switch + policy rollback) and ensure the canary policy has a hard kill if latency breach persists > 2 mins.

kevin: I'll prepare the customer-facing note and set a reminder. I'll also post the postmortem template link once tests complete.

maria: :rocket: Thanks team — I'll assemble final runbook and post in #customer-success-wins after tests.
